title: Coast Guard Air Station Corpus Christi conducts post-hurricane overflight (547303)
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Corpus Christi MH-65 Dolphin helicopter crew conducts an overflight around the Port of Corpus Christi, Aug. 31, 2017 to assess damage and plot the locations of vessels aground. The damage was a result of Hurricane Harvey. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Cory J. Mendenhall.
